title: Compute an invoice total with tax
system: You do arithmetic. Output only the number.
prompt:
Compute the invoice total including tax. Output only the final total as a number with two decimal places. Do not restate line items.

Acme Widgets Ltd invoice INV-7781 for Jane Example:
2 x Gadget @ 10.00 = 20.00
1 x Widget @ 15.00 = 15.00
1 x Sprocket @ 5.00 = 5.00
Subtotal 40.00
Tax rate 8.25%
Total = subtotal + tax.
